name: cover-bg-b-eyes
prompt: Turn the attached film frame into the background picture for a 16:9 movie cover. Keep it: a colossal dark creature's face rising out of a black stormy sea, its two enormous glowing yellow-green eyes with thin slit pupils staring straight at us, and at the bottom centre a tiny manta with three small riders looking up at it. Make it polished cinematic key art: deep blacks, violet lightning in the storm clouds, rain, the eyes the brightest thing in the picture, the riders small but clear. Set the creature a little lower so the top quarter of the picture is dark storm sky with nothing in it, for a title. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border. Landscape 16:9.
